title: SearchEventsRequest
description: Request schema for the search_events tool.

startDateFrom.description: Optional lower bound filter. Includes events starting on or after this date/time. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ).

startDateTo.description: Optional upper bound filter. Includes events starting on or before this date/time. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ).

places.description: Optional list of SPECIFIC VENUE Artsdata URIs (e.g., ["http://kg.artsdata.ca/resource/K5-69"]) for a theatre, hall, auditorium, room, or stage. Resolve venue or geographic place names (e.g., 'Toronto', 'Canada') to a URI using search_entities (types: ['Place']) or sparql_query filtering. Place URIs automatically include events at sub-venues contained within them. Can be left empty.

artists.description: Optional list of Artsdata artist URIs (e.g., ["http://kg.artsdata.ca/resource/K2-6574"]). If you only have a name, use search_entities (types: ['Person']) to find its URI first. Can be left empty.

organizations.description: Optional list of Artsdata organization URIs (e.g., ["http://kg.artsdata.ca/resource/K5-72"]). If you only have a name, use search_entities (types: ['Organization']) to find its URI first. Can be left empty.

types.description: Optional list of event type URIs, e.g. "http://schema.org/Event", "http://schema.org/MusicEvent". Can be empty.

language.description: Language for the labels in the response (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); default is 'en'. This selects the output language only — it does NOT filter events by the language they are performed in.
